originalTitle: Global Freight Corridors Adapt to Shifting Tariff Agreements and Multimodal Logistics
originalContent: Supply chain operators are restructuring maritime and rail freight channels to mitigate costs associated with evolving regional trade pacts. Investments in automated customs verification systems have reduced port turnaround times across major European and Asian transport hubs. Industry trade bodies project that supply chain resilience will take precedence over just-in-time inventory models.
